Test Title: Verify the Features on the Checkout Complete Page
Description: Validate that the static elements, success messages, and navigation buttons are displayed correctly on the Checkout Complete page.
Pre-conditions:
1. The browser is launched.
2. The user navigates to the application Base URL.
3. The user logs in successfully with a valid account (valid_user).
Steps:
1. Perform a complete checkout flow (Add item -> Cart -> Checkout Info -> Overview -> Finish).
2. Verify the Page Title text.
3. Verify the "Pony Express" logo is visible.
4. Verify the Success Header text.
5. Verify the Success Body text.
6. Verify the "Back Home" button text.
Expected:
1. Page Title is "Checkout: Complete!".
2. Logo is visible.
3. Success Header is "Thank you for your order!".
4. Success Text is "Your order has been dispatched, and will arrive just as fast as the pony can get there!".
5. Button text is "Back Home".

Test Title: Verify that "BackHome" Link redirected back to the Product Page
Description: Validate that the "Back Home" button successfully redirects the user to the Inventory/Product page.
Steps:
1. Perform a complete checkout flow.
2. Click the "Back Home" button.
3. Verify the Product Page logo is present.
Expected: 1. User is redirected to the Product page.

Test Title: Verify Cart is Empty After Checkout Completion
Description: Validate that the shopping cart is cleared (reset to 0 items) after a successful transaction.
Steps:
1. Perform a complete checkout flow.
2. Click the "Back Home" button to return to the inventory.
3. Inspect the shopping cart badge.
Expected: 1. The shopping cart badge count does not exist (indicating the cart is empty).
